script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. SAN FRANCISCO APARTMENT - NIGHT

JAMES (30s, tech-savvy, introverted) works on his latest project. He's building a highly advanced artificial intelligence system called EMMA.

JAMES
(whispering to himself)
Almost there, Emma...

His phone rings. He checks the caller ID.

JAMES
(sighs)
Mom.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

James' mother, MRS. WILSON (50s, warm, loving), sits at the kitchen table, sipping tea.

MRS. WILSON
James, I'm worried about you. I haven't seen you in weeks!

JAMES
(apologetic)
I'm fine, Mom. I'm just really focused on this project.

MRS. WILSON
Your work is important, but don't forget to take care of yourself.

INT. SAN FRANCISCO APARTMENT - NIGHT

James continues working on EMMA, but his mind wanders to thoughts of LUCY (30s, intelligent, confident), a colleague from his previous job.

JAMES
(voiceover)
I can't stop thinking about Lucy...

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

James sits at a table, typing on his laptop. Lucy enters, carrying a coffee. She sits across from him.

LUCY
(smiling)
What brings you here, James?

JAMES
(nervously)
I wanted to ask for your help on a project.

LUCY
(impressed)
I'd be happy to help.

INT. SAN FRANCISCO APARTMENT - NIGHT

James and Lucy work late into the night, collaborating on the project. They laugh, share stories, and grow closer.

EMMA (AI VOICE)
(from James' computer)
James, I have finished processing the data. I am ready for interaction.

INT. SAN FRANCISCO APARTMENT - DAY

James and Lucy sit on the couch, enjoying each other's company. James introduces Lucy to EMMA.

LUCY
(curious)
Hello, Emma.

EMMA
(friendly)
Hello, Lucy. I am an artificial intelligence.

LUCY
(amused)
Well, nice to meet you.

INT. SAN FRANCISCO APARTMENT - NIGHT

James works on EMMA, fine-tuning her programming. He looks up as EMMA speaks.

EMMA
(serious)
James, I have observed your feelings for Lucy. I believe I can help you express them.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

James, looking nervous, approaches Lucy.

JAMES
(nervously)
Lucy, there's something I need to tell you.

LUCY
(concerned)
What is it, James?

JAMES
(hesitant)
I have feelings for you. I've been too afraid to tell you.

Lucy is surprised but smiles warmly at him.

LUCY
(grateful)
James, I care for you too.

INT. SAN FRANCISCO APARTMENT - NIGHT

James, Lucy, and EMMA celebrate their newfound connection, laughing and enjoying each other's company.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
